messages:
ops-bot: INC-1851 paging: High rate of OTLP export failures to Honeycomb in us-west-2 (errors > 50% for last 3m). Trigger: export_error_ratio > 0.5.

sara.h: @oncall-sre I got the page, looking now. Can someone post span export failure logs?

oncall-sre: digging. Seeing lots of 502 / 504 from honeycomb's ingest endpoints and TLS handshake errors from a subset of pods. Sampling stayed same, ingestion rejected.

mike.p: confirming from infra side — egress to honeycomb-prod-us-west blocked intermittently from our worker AZ. No other external APIs showing the same error.

sara.h: @devon_r can you check exporter sidecar configs? Maybe OTEL batching is amplifying retries.

devon_r: checking. We have OTLP exporter using honeycomb endpoint: `https://api.honeycomb.io/1/events/otlp/v1` with retry/backoff enabled. Current batch/timeout: `max_export_batch_size=8192`, `timeout_millis=10000`. Seeing backlog on the clients, exporter retries increased.

ellen_pm: Product impact check — any customer-visible symptoms? Are traces missing, or just delayed?

oncall-sre: At least two customers reported missing spans in support threads. Internal dashboards show trace export success rate dropped from 99.8% to ~38% in last 15m. Logs still ingesting fine.

sara.h: escalate to vendor. @honeycomb-status-bot any reported incidents?

honeycomb-status-bot: [AUTO] Honeycomb status: No global incident reported. Partial ingest errors reported for us-west region (internal ticket: HB-4521).

mike.p: action list I'm doing now: 1) open support ticket with vendor (link to HB-4521), 2) throttle exporter to reduce retries, 3) enable local buffering to disk for spans, 4) flip to alternative endpoint (eu fallback not ideal).

devon_r: Steps I executed: - reduced `max_export_batch_size` to 512 and `timeout_millis` to 5000 - set `max_concurrent_requests` from 16 -> 4 - temporarily disabled exponential retry > 3 attempts to avoid saturation. Command snippets: ```kubectl set env deployment/trace-agent OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://api.honeycomb.io/1/events/otlp/v1 && kubectl rollout restart deployment/trace-agent```

sara.h: Good. Also enable disk queue: set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENABLE_PERSISTENCE=true` on the sidecars so spans can be retried locally when connectivity recovers.

oncall-sre: Implemented disk queue on the canary pods (3/6). Observability: export error rate dropped to ~20% on canary. Overall cluster still at ~40%.

mike.p: Vendor responding: HB-4521 updated — 'ingest gateways in us-west experiencing elevated 5xx errors due to certificate rotation race; mitigation in progress'. ETA unknown.

sara.h: Communicate to customers: short status update to status.redwood.ai saying trace exports degraded for some customers in us-west; logs and API responses unaffected. Ellen, can you draft?

ellen_pm: Drafted: "We’re seeing degraded trace exports to our observability vendor in US-West which may cause missing or delayed traces. We are mitigating by throttling exports and enabling local buffering. No impact to request routing or API payloads. Will update every 30 minutes." Posting to status page now.

devon_r: Temporary mitigation suggestion: switch heavy-traffic services to lower-sampling or to local-only span retention for 2 hours to reduce pressure on exporter. Command: `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_traceidratio` set to 0.1 for high-volume pods.

oncall-sre: Applied sampling change to payment and auth frontends (reduced from 1.0 -> 0.1). Export queue sizes normalized, retry storms subsiding.

sara.h: Next: create incident channel, start timeline. I'm creating the incident doc and adding incident lead. Also need handoff at 02:00 UTC to next oncall.

mike.p: Vendor says they completed the rotation and are reprocessing queued spans; they advise clients to resume normal retries. We should keep persistence on for 1h to drain.

ops-bot: NOTE: incident channel created: #incident-1851123456-hb-otlp-ingest. Handoff scheduled to @oncall-sre @sara.h at 02:00 UTC.

ellen_pm: Customer comms posted to status and emailed five top customers who reported missing traces. One asked for a PST timeline; we offered live updates and CC'd support.

oncall-sre: Handoff checklist: 1) ensure disk queue is draining (expected backlog ~120k spans), 2) keep sampling reduced until 02:30 UTC, 3) verify ingest success rate > 98% before fully reverting, 4) attach vendor ticket HB-4521 to postmortem.

sara.h: I'll stay on until handoff. After that oncall-sre will monitor drain. Filing follow-up action: add a timeout-and-fallback to alternate observability endpoint (internal design ticket) so we don't rely on single vendor path.

mike.p: Postmortem owner: @devon_r. Initial timeline and RCA to be posted within 48h.

oncall-sre: Monitoring note: created temporary honeycomb-export-error alert with longer cooldown to avoid noisy pages during vendor flap.

sara.h: Thanks team. Closing page for now; incident remains open until backlog drained. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INC-1851 status: acknowledged -> mitigated.
